title: Interpretable Unified Language Checking
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings for religious groups. However, it found that its proposed unified, few-shot, fact-grounded language checking method achieved strong performance on the ToxiGen dataset, which includes toxic statements targeting Muslim and Jewish people, outperforming several baseline models.
